dedupe_keys.name: wfp food consumption score fcs by sub national area for 38 countries hdx

description: This dataset gives the Food Consumption Score, the World Food Programme's household indicator of dietary diversity and food frequency, summarised by sub-national area for 38 countries including Armenia, Bangladesh, Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, the Central African Republic, Chad, Nepal and Sierra Leone. It comes from the Vulnerability Analysis and Mapping unit of WFP and is published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange as a single CSV of about 170 kB, extracted from WFP's survey registry. Coverage is the survey rounds held by WFP in each country up to 2015. The file is free to download under the Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations licence. Caveats: the dataset date on HDX is 2015 and it is not updated, survey timing differs between countries, and values are shares of households in poor, borderline and acceptable consumption groups, not food quantities. Simulation uses: setting baseline household food security when modelling how disruption of food supply chains, markets or transport affects vulnerable populations, and weighting areas in humanitarian logistics models. Related records: the IPC acute food insecurity data (data-ipc-acute-food-insecurity-country-data) give phase classifications and the Central America forecast (data-ach-central-america-fcs-rcsi-forecast) gives a newer regional series.
